4236.title: Accepted transcription is cancelled on unmount
4236.rootCauseOneLine: Unmount cleanup aborts accepted transcription, and the success adapter has no destination after its editor ref clears.
4236.proposedFix: Preserve accepted requests and route completed text to the originating draft through a stable accessor.
4236.caveats: Hook-level lifecycle reproduction; real microphone and browser navigation not exercised. Complete fix exceeds the automation five-file limit.
